title: session.provenance payload
description: Payload of a session.provenance fact: non-secret runtime correlations recorded during the Session (ADR 0002 — Facts and related records). Never carries credentials or bearer tokens (secret guard applies).

imageDigest.description: Admitted pinned image digest of the envelope (ADR 0006).

workloadIdentity.description: Scoped workload identity the Pod runs under.

runtimeIds.description: Non-secret runtime identifiers (process generation, bridge context id, policy version, ...).
